property_summary: For any inputs with a non-empty _tos array, the reference C never reverts from transfer(...) even when v == 0 (it always attempts the external calls and returns true), whereas the mutant reverts whenever v == 0; therefore the property: for any non-empty _tos and any v >= 0, calling transfer does not revert (reference holds for all such inputs, mutant fails when v==0).
change_summary: Insert an extra require that v > 0 so calls with v == 0 revert while original did not.
